DuetPartner.description: Who sings with the requester: a guest in the party, or a typed name. Neither = solo.
DuetPartner.title: DuetPartner

post.description: Give the admin a host identity in a party (so they can also queue songs).
Redeem a host invite shown on the TV menu (proof of physical access to the remote).

get.description: Search YouTube (requires a party credential so strangers can't burn the API quota).

put.description: Make a song a duet (or change/remove the partner). Empty body = solo again.

get.description: Curated songs by category, each with a ready-to-queue video. Costs no search quota.

post.description: Create an unpaired TV identity. The admin approves it by entering the pairing code.
Resume the TV's open party, or create a fresh one.
End any open party on this TV and start a new one (new join code).
Short-lived host link, shown as a QR in the TV menu (only reachable with the remote).

Player reports `started`, `ended` or `failed` for (item_id, generation).

Stale or duplicate events (wrong generation/item) are acknowledged with accepted=false and
change nothing, so a double ENDED can never skip two songs.

get.description: Validate a pasted YouTube link (or bare video ID) and return its metadata.
